title: Petition of MetroBus, Inc. pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 7, requesting a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity authorizing the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire in restricted common carriage service in the Cities of Boston and Cambridge, the Town of Brookline and public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority and the Metropolitan District Commission pursuant to an agreement with Medical Area Service Corporation.
